The '''Nerria system''' was a part of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Unidentified Nerrian piper|Nerrian piper]]|system=Nerria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> a [[Unidentified Nerrian piper|Nerrian piper]] who performed at the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TCW" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nerria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
